liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **What's Become Of The Baby** (4 reviews, 1 other source): The track plays through the PA while the band goes wild on stage; The Feedback into What's Become Of The Baby encore is not on DP 26 [3][5][8][9][11]
- **Feedback** (1 review): A long feedback section follows Viola Lee Blues and is the real highlight of the recording [5]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): The performance is rather sloppy but very intense [11]
- **The Eleven** (1 other source): The Eleven sits between two parts of The Other One, which then goes back into Cryptical Envelopment [1]
- **Caution Jam** (1 other source): A Caution jam sits inside Viola Lee Blues, which is played before and after it [1]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 other source): Pigpen ends the song with additional verses [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **26-69d1t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t02**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t03**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t04**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t05**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t06**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t07**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **26-69d1t08**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

## The recordings

- **gd69-04-26.sbd.yerys.71.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 166 min; rated 4.4/5 by 20 [1]
- **gd1969-04-26.sbd.miller.97393.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 27 songs; 172 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: The master reel has tape squeal in Lovelight, so the patch there was extended [2]
- **gd1969-04-26.sbd.gmb.96449.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 168 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1969-04-26.sbd.unknown.13390.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-04-26.sbd.yerys.71.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Ben Yerys; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Portions of this show appear on DP 26 and Fallout from the Phil Zone; The official release leaves out the encore, which the reviewer considers the best part of the show; Parts of the show are missing from the DP release [1][5][7][10]
- **gd1969-04-26.sbd.miller.97393.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Soundboard master cassette to cassette to DAT, with patches from another source (shnid 96449) to fill gaps [2]
- **gd1969-04-26.sbd.gmb.96449.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Soundboard Cassette x 1 > DAT; Encore Source: 7 inch Master Reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk > DAT [3]. Also: The vault holds two soundboard masters, cassettes and 140 minutes of reels. The reels lack the encore because that machine played the tape [3]
- **gd1969-04-26.sbd.unknown.13390.shnf**: source: MCas>Cas>DAT>circulation [4]
